snippet.title: Guns of Eschaton | Soulslike FPS Western | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Blessed are the forehanded. Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734220/

The time is nigh. Revelation comes December 8th. Prepare for a soulslike FPS experience unlike anything you've seen before, solo or in co-op.

Pick up your trusted irons. Die. Rise. Die again. Go West.
